entries.description: PII Guard is an open-source OpenAI-compatible privacy gateway that detects personal data in text and images, replaces it with reversible placeholders before prompts leave, and restores the original values in model responses.
representativeQueries: Pseudonymize PII before sending prompts to an LLM
Restore placeholders in model responses back to original values
Configure per-entity redaction and pseudonymization policies

entries.description: Machine-readable overview of PII Guard capabilities, public pages, OpenAI-compatible gateway endpoints, privacy boundaries, and benchmark evaluations.

What API endpoints and entity policies does PII Guard support?
